decision_table.name: Determine_AL_Filing_Requirement
decision_table.description: Determine if corporation must file Alabama state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition.name: has_physical_presence
condition.comment: Has physical presence in Alabama (office, employees, property)

condition.name: has_economic_nexus
condition.comment: Meets Alabama economic nexus threshold ($250,000 gross receipts)

actions.action: // Physical nexus established - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Alabama filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state).
Reference: AL Code § 40-18-1 (General provisions) Reference: AL Form 20C Instructions

actions.action: // Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required // Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500

rule.policy:
Alabama filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $250,000 gross receipts from Alabama customers.
Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018) Reference: AL Department of Revenue Notice - Economic Nexus Standards
No Alabama nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AL_Income_Adjustments
decision_table.description: Calculate Alabama state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments

rule.policy:
Alabama state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income.
Additions may include: - Interest on federal obligations (exempt federally but taxable to Alabama) - IRC Section 199A deduction addback (if Alabama doesn't conform) - State taxes deducted on federal return
Subtractions may include: - Interest on Alabama state and municipal bonds - Alabama net operating loss deduction
Reference: AL Form 20C Instructions (Schedule A - Adjustments to Income) Reference: AL Code § 40-18-35 (Net operating loss deduction)
No nexus - no state adjustments calculated.

decision_table.name: Calculate_AL_State_Tax
decision_table.description: Calculate Alabama state corporate income tax. Applies 6.5% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition.name: has_nexus
condition.comment: Must have nexus to owe tax

rule.policy:
Alabama state corporate income tax calculation:
1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28] 2. Apportioned to Alabama: × [Single-sales apportionment %] 3. Alabama additions: + [Additions from Schedule A] 4. Alabama subtractions: - [Subtractions from Schedule A] 5. Alabama taxable income: = [Adjusted income] 6. Alabama tax rate: × 6.5% 7. Alabama income tax: = [Tax before credits] 8. Alabama credits: - [Credits (jobs, R&D, etc.)] 9. Alabama tax liability: = [Final tax]
Reference: AL Form 20C (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions Reference: AL Code § 40-18-31 (Tax rate: 6.5% flat rate) Reference: AL Department of Revenue - Corporate Income Tax Guide
No Alabama nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded.
No Alabama taxable income - no tax liability. Alabama NOL rules may apply for future years (AL Code § 40-18-35).
